name: AppResetEntry
role: Application reset entry: vector slots 117-119 (reset, COP, clock monitor) point here; the flash tool's final 31 01 FF 02 address (local 0xCBA5). Writes IVBR=0xEE, MMCCTL1, DIRECT, CLKSEL/PLLCTL, then JMP 0xC000.

name: AppStartup
role: Reached by JMP 0xC000 from AppResetEntry; opens LDS #0x2200 then CALL 0x8000 page FE. Start of seg1.

name: AppVectorTable
role: Relocated S12X interrupt vector table (seg2, 120 words, local 0xEE10-0xEEFF); IVBR is set to 0xEE by AppResetEntry.

name: SwitchWordTable
role: Compiler switch helper, JSR'd with an inline table after the call: [N:u16][default:addr16][addr16 x N], selector in D. Does not return to the caller.

name: SwitchByteOffset
role: Compiler switch helper, inline table [N:u8][default:u8][off:u8 x N]; target = (address after the JSR) + 2 + off. Does not return to the caller.

name: SwitchSparse
role: Compiler switch helper, inline table [max:u8][default:addr16] then sorted ([key:u8][addr16]) entries up to key == max; ends JMP [1,X]. Does not return to the caller.

name: StartupCopyDown
role: C start-up: zeroes the ranges listed at 0xC011, then walks the copy-down list at [0xC013] ([size u16][GPAGE u8][dest u16][bytes], size 0 ends; 7 entries from 0xCD01).

name: AppMain
role: Called by AppStartup after StartupCopyDown: peripheral init (Can0Init among it), then the endless main loop (RTI tick flag, %4/%10/%20 task flags, CanTask every pass).

name: Can0TxIsr
role: CAN0 transmit ISR, vector slot 68: reads CANTFLG & CANTIER, masks the serviced TX interrupts off, calls 0xFE:9F4A.

name: Can0RxIsr
role: CAN0 receive ISR, vector slot 69: calls CanRxFetch, then clears RXF (CANRFLG = 1).

name: Can0ErrIsr
role: CAN0 error/status ISR, vector slot 70: reads CANRFLG, records status in 0x2A29, writes 0xFE to CANRFLG.

name: RtiIsr
role: RTI ISR, vector slot 112 (RTICTL 0x49: 5.12 ms if f_osc 16 MHz): sets RtiTickFlag, increments TickCounter32, steps software timers at 0x363A, subtracts 5 from each periodic CAN TX countdown.

name: Can0Init
role: CAN0 init: CANCTL1 0x80, CANIDAC eight 8-bit filters (table in hvac notes 5.1), BTR0/1 0x41/0x76 (f_osc/32). The only writer of the filter registers.

name: Can0TxLoad
role: Loads an MSCAN TX buffer: CANTBSEL, IDR0-3, data 0x174-, DLC 0x17C, priority 0x17D. Called only by CanTxService.

name: Can0RxRead
role: Reads the MSCAN RX buffer: ID (standard or extended) to [0x3012], flags, DLC, data bytes from 0x164 to [0x301A].

name: CanRxFetch
role: Calls Can0RxRead with the pointer block 0x3012-0x301A; on success clears CanRxProcessed and sets the bus-silence deadline 0x3004 = now + 300 ticks.

name: CanRxDispatch
role: Received-ID dispatcher: skips if CanRxProcessed set, else 32-bit compares the ID with 0x051 0x1D5 0x215 0x241 0x274 0x275 0x277 0x370 0x378 0x382 0x383 0x390 0x439 0x48A 0x491 0x643 0x750 0x7DF and calls the handler.

name: CanTxQueue
role: Queues a 16-byte TX descriptor (D = pointer): +0 type 0 = one-shot FIFO at 0x2E80, 1 = periodic table at 0x2D8E keyed by ID (known ID: data refreshed only). Exactly 8 callers: 4 packers and 4 in the diagnostic transport.

name: CanTxService
role: Sends one frame per call: one-shot queue first, else the next periodic entry whose countdown is 0, which is reloaded from its +1 period.

name: CanTask
role: Called every main-loop pass: CanTxService, RX fetch if RXF pending, CanRxDispatch, then the 0x3004 and 0x3008 deadlines into 0x3D2A and 0x3D2B.

name: TxPack_0x410
role: Packs and queues 0x410 AC_Compressor_Command (bytes in hvac notes 5.2).

name: TxPack_0x276
role: Packs and queues 0x276 HVACStatus (bytes in hvac notes 5.2).

name: TxPack_0x391
role: Packs and queues 0x391 HVACAirState (bytes in hvac notes 5.2).

name: TxPack_0x392
role: Packs and queues 0x392, not in the DBC (bytes in hvac notes 5.2).

name: RxHandler_0x051
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x051 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x1D5
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x1D5 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x215
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x215 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x241
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x241 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x274
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x274 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x275
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x275 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x277
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x277 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x370
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x370 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x378
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x378 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x382
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x382 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x383
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x383 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x390
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x390 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x439
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x439 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x48A
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x48A (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x491
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x491 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RxHandler_0x643
role: CanRxDispatch handler for 0x643 (bytes used in hvac notes 5.3).

name: RtiTickFlag
role: Set to 1 by RtiIsr, cleared by AppMain when it runs the tick tasks.

name: MainTickCount
role: u8 tick counter in AppMain; %4, %10, %20 select the task groups (the %20 group repacks the four CAN messages).

name: CanRxData
role: Received frame data B0-B7 (one buffer), read by every RxHandler.

name: CanRxId
role: Received frame ID, u32, compared by CanRxDispatch.

name: CanRxProcessed
role: Cleared by CanRxFetch on a new frame, set to 1 by every RxHandler.

name: CanTxDesc
role: TX descriptor filled by the packers: +0 type, +1 u16 period reload, +3 u16 countdown, +5 u16 ID, +7..+14 data, +15 DLC.

name: CanTxPeriodicTable
role: Periodic TX entries, 15 x 16 bytes in CanTxDesc layout; countdown at +3 decremented by 5 per RTI tick.

name: CanTxOneShotQueue
role: One-shot TX FIFO, 15 x 16 bytes, served before the periodic table.

name: TickCounter32
role: 32-bit RTI tick counter, high word at 0x369A, low word at 0x369C; incremented by RtiIsr.

name: Rx215_SpeedMisread
role: 0x215 handler result B0 << ((B1+8)&0xFF): vehicle speed read with the precedence bug (H4); input of the lookups in 0x7EEF17 and 0x7F200F.

name: Rx390_AllowedCellTempMax
role: Copy of 0x390 B4 (DBC AllowedCellTempMax); read by 0x7EC9C1 (H6).

name: Rx390_AllowedCellTempMin
role: Copy of 0x390 B5 (DBC AllowedCellTempMin); read by 0x7EC9C1 (H6).

name: Rx390_AllowedCellTempDiff
role: Copy of 0x390 B6 (DBC AllowedCellTempDiff); read by 0x7EC9C1 (H6).

name: Rx390_AllowedHumidity
role: Copy of 0x390 B7 (DBC AllowedHumidity).

name: IsoTpRx
role: ISO-TP receive for 0x750/0x7DF: PCI switch, assembles the request at 0x3035, calls UdsDispatch when complete.

name: UdsDispatch
role: UDS service dispatcher: SID 0x2FED, NRC 0x2FF9, per-service session/length/physical gates (notes 6.2).

name: Uds10_SessionControl
role: 0x10: 01 default, 02 programming (needs 0x2A06=2), 03 extended.

name: Uds11_EcuReset
role: 0x11 01: needs 0x2A06 = 1 or 2; writes 1 to COPCTL 0x003C.

name: Uds27_SecurityAccess
role: 0x27 01/02 and 03/04; seeds at 0x2A24/0x2A20; success sets 0x2A06.

name: Uds28_CommControl
role: 0x28: sub 00 sets 0x2211 (TX on), sub 01 clears it.

name: Uds85_ControlDtcSetting
role: 0x85: sets 0x2212; unreachable because the dispatcher and handler length checks conflict.

name: Uds22_ReadDid
role: 0x22: routes by DID range (notes 6.4).

name: Uds2E_WriteDid
role: 0x2E: E1xx/E3xx RAM windows; E0xx/E2xx refused; no session or security gate.

name: Uds2F_IoControl
role: 0x2F: DID-table overrides and the 0x6300/0x6301 port overrides; extended session, no security gate.

name: Uds14_ClearDtc
role: 0x14 FFFFFF.

name: Uds19_ReadDtcInfo
role: 0x19 (and 0x17): subs 01, 02, 04, 0A via the helper 0x7FCAEA.

name: UdsSendNegative
role: Sends 7F SID NRC on 0x758.

name: UdsSessionTimeout
role: Session timer 2 expiry: back to default, TX and DTC setting on, overrides cleared.

name: SwTimerStart
role: Start software timer n (table 0x363A, 6 bytes each, -5 per RTI tick).

name: SwTimerStop
role: Stop software timer n.

name: SwTimerExpired
role: Returns 1 when software timer n has expired.

name: SeedToKey
role: SecurityAccess key: seed ^ const, 48 LFSR rounds (taps 29,20,11,4); hvacsim/seedkey.py.

name: UdsRand
role: Park-Miller style random generator used for seeds.

name: MemCopy
role: memcpy(dest, src, n): dest pushed first, n in D.

name: DidReadTable
role: Reads a DID-table row (0x7FC23A) into the response.

name: DidWriteOverride
role: Writes an I/O-control value into a DID row override shadows.

name: DidTableSize
role: Returns the size of a DID-table row, 0 if absent.

name: DidTableIndex
role: Returns the row index of a DID in the DID table.

name: DidE1Write
role: 2E E1nn: 4 request bytes -> RAM 0x2214 + 4*nn.

name: DidE1Read
role: 22 E1nn: RAM 0x2214 + 4*nn -> response.

name: DidE3Write
role: 2E E3nn: request -> RAM 0x3C28 + 4*nn.

name: DidE3Read
role: 22 E3nn: RAM 0x3C28 + 4*nn -> response.

name: DidStoreRead
role: 22 E0xx/E2xx through the E-DID table 0x2A2C.

name: DidStoreWrite
role: 2E E0xx/E2xx through the E-DID table; refused by flag bit 1 in every row.

name: PortOutputs
role: Writes PORTA/PORTC/PORTD from 0x3D69/0x3D79/0x3D6A with the 0x6301 overrides.

name: PortInputs
role: PORTB -> 0x3C83 with the 0x6300 override.

name: RoutineStartById
role: Routine table 0x7FC024 lookup; 7010 start side effects.

name: RoutineRunner
role: Main-loop runner of routine 7010 (pass when 0x3D2C/32/38/3E all 1).

name: DidTable
role: 55 rows of 24 bytes: [DID][size] then [width][source][override shadow] x4.

name: RoutineTable
role: 8 rows [RID u16][index u8].

name: EDidTable
role: 6 rows [DID][store offset][length][flags]; flags 0x03 refuse writes.

name: UdsSession
role: 0 default, 1 programming, 2 extended.

name: UdsSecurityLevel
role: 0 locked, 1 level 01/02, 2 level 03/04; never cleared until reset.

name: UdsNrc
role: NRC of the current request (0 = positive).

name: UdsRequest
role: Request buffer, SID first.

name: UdsRequestLen
role: Low byte of the request length.

name: UdsRxId
role: CAN ID of the current request (0x750 or 0x7DF).

name: UdsTxEnabled
role: CommunicationControl: 1 = transmit on.

name: UdsDtcSettingOn
role: ControlDTCSetting: 1 = on.

name: DidOverrideFlags
role: I/O-control flag (mask byte) per DID-table row; copied into 0x7F200F each step.

name: RamWindowE1
role: RAM read/written by 22/2E E100-E1FE; initialised by the copy-down.

name: RamWindowE3
role: RAM read/written by 22/2E E300-E331; read by 0x7F1C7E as flag/value pairs.

name: TaskScheduler
role: Multirate scheduler: 0x7F1C7E every call, 0x7F200F every 2nd, 0x7F37B4 every 10th, 0x7EC000/0x7EC8AF/0x7EC9C1 every 50th.

name: ThermalModelStep
role: Generated thermal model step: copies CAN/sensor inputs to 0x37xx, calls the sub-blocks, writes outputs incl. 0x3E50 = 0x37C4.

name: ThermalModelInit
role: Model init: temperature inputs 0x50 (0 degC), CAN temperatures 0x80, sub-block inits.

name: PackThermalBlock
role: Model sub-block: pack heat demand ramp -> 0x3818, demand ramp 0x2405 -> 0x3807, the 0x39D3 chart (0x3758 bit 2).

name: ModeChartA
role: Mode chart: 0x37C4 from 0x374E bits 3/2/1 and 0x3756/0x3753 bit 0.

name: ModeChartB
role: Mode chart (second instance, called from ThermalModelStep with arg 0): writes 0x37C4.

name: Lookup2D
role: 2-D table lookup: (out, table, u1, bp1, n1, u2, bp2, n2 in D).

name: AdcInputs
role: Starts ATD0/ATD1 sequences, copies results to 0x2F7E/0x2F9E and on to 0x3C7B-0x3CA0.

name: Atd0Results
role: Copies ATD0 ch0-15 from 0x2D58 to a caller buffer if 0x2D55 is set.

name: Atd1Results
role: Copies ATD1 ch0-7 from 0x2D7C to a caller buffer if 0x2D78 is set.

name: Atd0Isr
role: ATD0 conversion ISR: result to 0x2D58+2ch; after 16 sets 0x2D55.

name: Atd1Isr
role: ATD1 conversion ISR: result to 0x2D7C+2ch; after 8 sets 0x2D78.

name: EeeParamLoad
role: Start-up: E233 block (200 bytes, E265 checksum) from 0x13:F52C to RAM 0x3E76, flash defaults 0xC762 on mismatch.

name: CalAllowMaxOffset
role: Used with AllowedCellTempMax: (0x37DA x 2 - value) >> 1 in 0x7FA1D5 (decompile, not emulated); E1AD byte 0.

name: CalAllowMinOffset
role: Offset on AllowedCellTempMin: heat target = AllowMin + value/4 degC (emulated); E1AD byte 1.

name: CalChartHystA
role: Read by the 0x39D3 chart in 0x7FA1D5 (notes 7.7); E1AD byte 2.

name: CalChartHystB
role: Read by the 0x39D3 chart in 0x7FA1D5 (notes 7.7); E1AD byte 3.

name: ModelMode
role: Model mode nibble -> 0x3E50 -> 0x276 B2 bits 5:2.

name: PackHeatDemand
role: 50 + 0.4 x heat demand (0-200); > 50 sets 0x3756 bit 0.

name: ModelTmin
role: Min cell temperature, (T+40) x 2.

name: ModelTmax
role: Max cell temperature, (T+40) x 2.

name: ModelAllowMax
role: 0x390 AllowedCellTempMax, (T+40) x 2.

name: ModelAllowMin
role: 0x390 AllowedCellTempMin, (T+40) x 2.

name: ModelAllowDiff
role: 0x390 AllowedCellTempDiff, same offset as the temperatures.

name: Atd0Done
role: Set by Atd0Isr when a 16-channel sequence completes.

name: Atd1Done
role: Set by Atd1Isr when an 8-channel sequence completes.
